Ada Mensah. Open the estimate.

What supports a battery-life claim?

I wrote Mosslink’s firmware and scheduled its power states. The two-year battery figure is a projection; there is no field endurance or weather testing to support it.

Six machined sections make a symbolic sensor enclosure. They are explanatory geometry, not a reconstruction of Mosslink.

Email Ada · Read the conclusion

2 / State table · Transition

A teaching cycle, an unresolved observation.

Sleep, Measure and Transmit are a teaching sequence, with no actual firmware state names, durations or current values claimed. Separately, a current trace showed the radio staying awake after a failed transmission.

Six machined sections make a symbolic sensor enclosure. They are explanatory geometry, not a reconstruction of Mosslink.

3 / State table · Claim

Projection and run: different evidence.

The longest run was 72 hours. I want to make the basis of a claim visible: measured bench current supports the estimate, while an observed run supports a different statement.

Six machined sections make a symbolic sensor enclosure. They are explanatory geometry, not a reconstruction of Mosslink.
